note: Order from the 1-ID-E panel (cs04, CS-Studio screenshot; 'Last update 11-12-2026'; phone photo p14 showed layout date 03-04-2026, element order unchanged). Panel sections: [Beam Conditioning System: IC1+2, Slit US, IC3, FS, Lens1-4, Slit DS, IC4] [Aero SMS + Aero_Tr + Tomo D1 + NF D2] [IC5, D3] [IC6, Hydra D4] [VFF D5, Radiograph, IC8, SAXS D6]. HL-SMS is drawn in its own box ABOVE the beam line over the sample region. IC readouts are scaler channels '1ide2:...'. The hutch outline on the panel has a chamfered upper-right corner. Overview (cs01) buttons for E: Slits, 1ide, 1ide1 (motor IOC prefixes), Mot.

elements.name: Tomo D1
elements.notes: Tomo D1 in E. CONFIRMED by the user: the gh1 camera (IOC 1idGH1:) is on Tomo D1. 'Tomo_E' screen (cs14: E-Tomo Y, Rz, X, Z; axes +Y up, +Z beam, +X into the screen) = 1ide1:m40 (Y), m38 (Rz), m63 (X), m62 (Z). On the panel Tomo D1 is drawn above the beam line and NF D2 below it (both beside the Aero SMS), so they look like alternative detectors moved into the beam rather than in series (inferred, unconfirmed). The tomoEds axes (m111, m112) are NOT here: the user says they belong to the Radiograph (2026-11-13).
elements.user: user 2026-11-12: gh1 belongs to Tomo D1 (cs14 Tomo_E)

elements.name: NF D2
elements.notes: Near-field detector. Retractable placement inferred from the panel layout (see tomoE).

elements.name: D3
elements.notes: Shared position: ONE of GE5, Pilatus 2M or Eiger16M is mounted at D3 at any time (user 2026-11-12). Which one is installed varies by experiment; GE5 has its own motion.
elements.user: user 2026-11-12: D3 is one position used by different detectors, one at a time: GE5, Pilatus or Eiger

elements.name: Hydra D4
elements.notes: Hydra D4 is the far-field detector made of GE1, GE2, GE3 and GE4 (four panels that move together; user 2026-11-12). CAM-9 tag below it on the panel. GE5 is a separate detector with its own motion (it is used at D3).
elements.user: user 2026-11-12: Hydra = GE1-GE4, four panels moving together

elements.name: VFF D5
elements.notes: pg1 may be the camera of VFF D5 or of the Radiograph (user, unconfirmed).

elements.name: Radiograph
elements.notes: Radiograph detector on tall aluminium columns (label 'Rad Grph' in p09). A monitor in hutch E shows its live image (p09, p10): a conical pin on a knurled cap, crosshair drawn in marker. Its translation axes are the mpe_bluesky 'tomoEds' pair 1ide1:m111 / m112 (user, 2026-11-13). The camera on it is NOT assigned: the user suspects pg1 (reasoning: the pair that moves it is called tomoEds), not confirmed.
elements.user: user 2026-11-13: the tomoEds axes (1ide1:m111, m112) are on the Radiograph
